entities.summary: Comuneros Revolt, a transformative movement in Paraguay (1717–1735). Emerged from First Jesuit Reduction established and Buenos Aires re-founded from Asunción. Catalyzed Comuneros Revolt and Colonial Tensions and Guaraní War against Spanish-Portuguese treaty — 1754.
